name: praxis
description: A lean engineering framework for direct work and gated Campaign-to-Evolve delivery.

interface.shortDescription: A lean engineering framework for capable agents
interface.longDescription: Praxis keeps direct engineering work direct and gives unknown-heavy initiatives one explicit Campaign-to-Evolve state machine. Campaign discovers and gates vision, contracts, and uncertainty before waiting. Manually invoked Evolve gates a learning-ordered map, plans one authorized evolution, passes its mandatory plan gate, delivers it autonomously, passes a human result gate, and stops. Pair independently returns every mutation boundary to the user without removing gates. Durable state lets agents identify context, authority, next gate, and forbidden transitions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Keep direct work direct; otherwise resolve Praxis context, state, authority, next gate, and forbidden transition before acting.
